import json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('products/services/catalogue-qa/fixed-price-trial')
control = json.loads((root / 'director-byte-isolated-control.json').read_text())
clean, changed = control['runs']
assert clean['exit'] == 0 and clean['failed_checks'] == []
assert changed['exit'] == 1
assert set(changed['failed_checks']) == {'identifiers_preserved_sku_barcode_color_size_price', 'variant_image_is_first_image_of_its_color'}
assert clean['cr_count'] == changed['cr_count'] == 0 and clean['lf_count'] == changed['lf_count']
changes = control['changes']
assert len(changes) == 2 and all(item['record'] == 20 and item['sku'] == 'SYN-B-BL-XXL' for item in changes)
source = root / 'director-fictional-buyer-report.md'
report = source.read_text()
for item in changes:
    assert all(str(item[key]) in report for key in ('sku', 'record', 'expected', 'observed'))
report += '\n## Verification and provisional scope\n\nTASK-179585850100 repeated the verification with only the two listed cell changes and the same line-ending counts. The clean file exited 0, and the modified file exited 1 with the two reported checks failing. The earlier fixture in TASK-179585676100 also failed a format check, which did not recur in the isolated control. That earlier run observed about 0.025 s and 0.074 s of verifier runtime. Report preparation, review, revisions and administration remain unmeasured. At hypothetical gross hourly rates of CAD 45, 60 and 90, CAD 60 covers at most 80, 60 and 40 total minutes respectively, before any deductions.\n\nKeep the quote provisional and narrow its scope to one offline comparison of up to 20 nonconfidential source variant rows, their image rows and the corresponding buyer-produced CSV, with one report identifying failed checks and manually confirmed records. Input-only work is limited to input validation. Exclude file repair, live Shopify import and any delivery-time commitment.\n'
output = root / 'buyer-report-isolated-control.md'
output.write_text(report)
print(output.read_text())
